name: Hongo-Sanchome
tagline: Otemachi in 6 minutes and Tokyo in 7 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000.
summary: The station is in Bunkyo City, where Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 6 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 22 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. The station stands 21.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 21.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 13.9 m to 27.8 m, a difference of 13.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 27 clinics and 25 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 飯田医院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京大学医学部附属病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line run through it. Toei Oedo Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line runs at 154% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大塚→茗荷谷, which this station is not on. Toei Oedo Line runs at 147%. Its busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥130,000 to ¥140,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. a small projected flood depth and plenty of places to eat out pushes the figure up. On the other side, many bars by the station and voices outside late at night holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Kasuga; for how close the centre is, Hongo-Sanchome.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hongo-Sanchome. Kasuga has the Toei Oedo Line and Toei Mita Line, a different set from Hongo-Sanchome. To Tokyo, for instance, Kasuga takes 6 minutes longer. A one-room flat costs about ¥19,000 less at Kasuga.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Suidobashi; for lower rent, Hongo-Sanchome.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hongo-Sanchome. Suidobashi has the JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) and Toei Mita Line, a different set from Hongo-Sanchome. To Shibuya, for instance, Suidobashi is 5 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥7,000 more at Suidobashi. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Hongo-Sanchome comes out ahead.
